insight.headline: Multiple Tracking Numbers
insight.what_changed: The `orderCreate` mutation in the GraphQL Admin API now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment. This is achieved by adding a `trackingNumbers` field to the `OrderCreateFulfillmentInput` type. The change allows for more accurate and detailed tracking information when importing orders.
insight.developer_impact: Developers using the `orderCreate` mutation should update their code to utilize the new `trackingNumbers` field for fulfillments. This may involve modifying existing order import logic to handle multiple tracking numbers per fulfillment. The update provides more flexibility and accuracy in tracking orders, but requires adjustments to existing implementations. Ensure that your app handles the new field correctly to avoid errors or data inconsistencies.
insight.merchant_impact: Merchants will benefit from more accurate and detailed tracking information for their orders, potentially improving customer satisfaction and reducing support queries related to order tracking.
insight.why_it_matters: This change matters because it enhances the functionality of the `orderCreate` mutation, allowing for more precise tracking and potentially improving the overall customer experience. It's an example of how Shopify's GraphQL Admin API is evolving to meet the needs of merchants and developers.

themes.title: Hydrogen Updates
themes.detail: Hydrogen developer preview update adds new capabilities, including Vue bindings, and Oxygen is now available on development stores. The @shopify/cli-hydrogen and @shopify/mini-oxygen packages have been updated with patch changes.

themes.title: GraphQL Admin API Enhancements
themes.detail: The orderCreate mutation now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment, and new fields are available for cash management activities and drawers in POS. Additionally, the Customer object in Shopify Functions now includes a createdAt field.

themes.title: Ecosystem and App Updates
themes.detail: The shopify-account component is now a Theme Store requirement, and merchants can see partner details on collaborator requests. The Shopify CLI has been updated to version 4.6.0, removing deprecated draftable extension processes and adding flags to avoid prompts.
